description: Creates a new file in a GitLab repository at the specified path with the given content. Use this action when you need to add a new file to a repository branch with a commit message.

author_email.description: The email address of the commit author. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's email.
author_email.title: Author Email

author_name.description: The name of the commit author. If not provided, uses the authenticated user's name.
author_name.title: Author Name

branch.description: The name of the branch where the file will be created.
branch.title: Branch

commit_message.description: The commit message describing why the file was created.
commit_message.title: Commit Message

content.description: The content of the file to create.
examples:
# My New File

This is the content.
content.title: Content

encoding.description: The encoding of the file content. Set to 'base64' if the content is base64-encoded. Default is 'text'.
encoding.title: Encoding

execute_filemode.description: Whether to enable the execute flag on the file (for executable files).
execute_filemode.title: Execute Filemode

file_path.description: The full path to the file to create within the repository (e.g., 'lib/class.rb' or 'docs/README.md').
file_path.title: File Path

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
project_id.title: Project Id

start_branch.description: Name of the base branch to create the new branch from. Only used if the specified branch does not exist.
start_branch.title: Start Branch

name: create_file

branch.description: The name of the branch where the file was created.
branch.title: Branch

file_path.description: The full path of the created file in the repository.
file_path.title: File Path
